protocol.status: final evaluation complete; do not tune on these results
protocol.selection: latest observation no later than horizon
protocol.series_limitation: No series IDs; complete UTC dates grouped; teams may recur
protocol.final_test_policy: No final test predictions until development and protocol freeze are complete
protocol.temporal_rule: Match clock from combat events; preceding raw tick states; active matches only
protocol.team_rule: Verified hero name to metadata draft; never infer side from replay slot order
protocol.primary_comparison: logistic versus neural_network; raw probabilities; seed averaged predictions for paired intervals
protocol.calibration_reporting: Always report raw and temperature adjusted probabilities; no choice using final outcomes
protocol.bootstrap_reporting: Match bootstrap per model; paired match and UTC day block bootstrap for primary comparison; descriptive intervals conditional on data
protocol.matched_cohort_reporting: Also report the neural model on common final matches observed at all horizons
protocol.conditional_hero_extension: Deferred: retrospective role timing provenance and generic inventory values prevent a defensible prospective extension in this study

limits: Fixed model bootstrap, training seed spread and bootstrap refitting describe different uncertainties
